propositions: Tracker re-cloning without carrying over git-ignored .env-id causes silent environment re-identification, minting a new UUID that orphans all prior attestations signed by the old environment.
The ensure-registry unit and _gen_local_files mint a fresh .env-id whenever it is absent, without checking whether the store already holds events stamped by a different environment.

Minting .env-id into a populated store must warn loudly on stderr, name the prior environment ID(s), document the attestation consequence, list the four git-ignored files to carry over, and provide an explicit override via REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1.

rebar fsck gains a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH check scoped by author to detect when the current environment's own authors also wrote events under a different env-id, without false-positives in healthy multi-clone topologies.
